measurement:bootcamp-positions.note: Curated boot-camp positions. S1/S2: X,Z measured from the verified footage radar, Y decoded from the adv_bootcamp map heightmap (t000007c1_terrain.glm, context 1985). S4 adds enemy standing positions from the client nameplate range readout (client/ui/overheadwindow.pyo _UpdateEntityRange shows ceil(distance)) plus radar player position and heading, the client map cursor readout for indicator 437, and Y from the heightmap or the derived adv_bootcamp navmesh (bias-calibrated against six references). Each position record states its method, uncertainty and frames. S5/S6 add radar objective-indicator icons told apart from creature pips by the client radar code (client/ui/radarwindow.pyo HandleUpdateObjectiveIndicators, _GetEntityRadarType), third-person camera-ray triangulation for the bomb, the nameplate range readout for the outpost Thrax, inferred reinforcement bearings on the pad, the original damaged-pad map anchor for the exit, and the Alia Das arrival from the wilderness radar texture with Y from the derived adv_foreas_concordia_wilderness navmesh. The Rogers turn-in (GAP-ROGERS) adds his command-tent position in context 1220 from the yellow handset radar icon (template NCC with per-frame wilderness radar matching) with Y from the derived wilderness navmesh. The Wilderness arrival (W1) adds Training Officer Kincaid in context 1220 from the yellow handset radar icon beside the barracks tent (one viewpoint, check SEG3-03), corroborated by the client map marker "Class Trainer: Alia Das".

scope.note: Creature 198514 (Outpost Commander Rogers, BootcampFixRogersTurnIn) is the 1995/2005 receiver and stands in context 1220 (placement 198684); it is a boot-camp key because it closes the boot-camp missions (GAP-ROGERS). Creature 198515 (Training Officer Kincaid, WildernessArrivalTrainingDay, slice W1) is the 1526 receiver in context 1220 (placement 198685); it continues the reserved keys as Rogers did (OD-36).

Placement 198684 (BootcampFixRogersTurnIn) is scoped to context 1220, not 1985: it is the turn-in NPC of the boot-camp missions 1995/2005, recorded here as the closing step of GAP-ROGERS, as S6 location 19852 records the Alia Das destination. Context 1220 is shared, so the placement carries no presence or alternate-state condition. Placement 198685 (Kincaid, WildernessArrivalTrainingDay) is likewise scoped to shared context 1220 with no presence or alternate-state condition (OD-36).

BootcampS2GearingUp seeded usable condition 198800, which lies outside this range (inside the content_placement range 198650-198899). The S2 condition has no manifest row, so the scope check does not see it; recorded 2026-09-14 for the planned ReconstructionSeedTests scope check. S4 conditions 198901-198902 are inside the range. S5 conditions 198903-198908 and S6 condition 198909 are inside the range. W1 condition 198910 (Training Day offer) is inside the range.
W1 rule 1985011 (WildernessArrivalTrainingDay) belongs to shared context 1220: the Training Day offer is the step that follows the boot-camp exit (OD-36).
Not listed separately in plan section 1.3: action rows are children of the reserved content_rule ids, so they share that range. W1 action (1985011, 0) follows its rule.

Not a reserved range: the client item template ids of the Training Day reward pistols (OD-38), whose itemtemplate_itemclass and itemtemplate_requirement_skill rows are original world-seed rows. Checked absent from itemtemplate in the deployed rasaworld.db (read-only, 2026-09-14) before WildernessArrivalTrainingDay inserts them.
As itemtemplate: the two reward pistol template ids, checked absent from itemtemplate_weapon in the deployed rasaworld.db (read-only, 2026-09-14).

W2: the D11 class-gear templates 122859-122871 (client item template ids, not a reserved range; the client side is the 122840-122880 block; checked absent from the deployed rasaworld.db itemtemplate, 2026-09-15).
W2: the Rage-O-Matic (122865) and Repair-O-Matic (122871) weapon rows (client template ids, not reserved).
W2: the ten D11 class-gear armor pieces. Their armor value is the client itemclass max_hp; the emulator world seed's five rows are the earlier creation armor.

W2: Quartermaster Caufield, the existing world-seed creature (id 132) whose missing dialogue package 133 is attached so missions 2010/2011 can complete at him. Not a reserved range: the id is the world-seed creature id.

gaps.summary: Closed by verification (2026-09-15): accounts are not forced to GM level 1. The live auth database shows 0 for new accounts (2, 3 and 5 are level 0) and a level only where it was granted deliberately (the test account 4 is 10). The `test` account at level 1 is a seed row, not a code path: the game reads `account.Level` and only the explicit `.gmlevel` command raises it (src/Rasa.Game/Game/Server.cs). The old evidence pointer (src/Rasa.Game/Client.cs:278-280) no longer exists. The remaining exposure is that .tele/.givelogos follow an account whose level is raised, which is intended for the test account.
evidence: read-only rasaauth.db: accounts 2, 3, 5 level 0; account 4 level 10
gaps.closes_with: closed by verification 2026-09-15 (live auth database + Server.cs)
